label: preparing
what: A jointly arranged evening community hospitality gathering in the hall at eighteen on day 1, with lanterns and two hundred feast loaves. The mayor was initially not told its purpose and the occasion/programme details were explicitly withheld until the gathering; the precise surprise is not revealed in this record. Innkeeper and builder are clearly organizers; freight is supported as a supply/coordinating participant. Baker knowingly provided paid catering, neighbour later spread invitations while preserving the surprise, and secretary helped schedule the visit and escort after informing the mayor; none of these helpers is established as knowing the undisclosed programme.
